kind: frozen synthetic MoGe-2 ViT-S Normal local CPU comparison; visual-only inferred evidence
decision: Sharper boundaries and accurate normals do not make native metric point geometry usable. Compared with DA3 C, local bounds/scatter remain poor or worse; do not build a camera solver around these lightweight outputs.
nextMilestone: Predeclare and test structural room-plane fitting on this same fixture, using neural normals/depth only as hints and the existing single explicit scale anchor; evaluate held-out planes/fireplace/prop errors before considering SfM or a larger model.
comparisonLimit: MoGe640x480 vs DA3252x196; same original rules on native grids, different physical1px tolerance and sample population. Cross-view metric cm scatter comparable by formula; pixel reprojection and F1 not equal-grid claims.
